name: kubekey-resumable-integrity-verified-c159
instr:
KubeKey lacks uniform resumable, integrity-verified artifact transfers. Implement them without changing successful module, connector environment, command, or retry behavior. Preserve destinations until verified content is published.

Derive stable transfer identities from task, host, loop item, direction, and destination. Isolate executions, hosts, items, directory members, and concurrent downloads. Report deterministic verified progress and final SHA-256 digests. Reuse retained bytes only after validating their prefix digest; otherwise restart safely. Final mismatches return `ErrTransferIntegrity` with exact text `transfer integrity verification failed`. Cancellation retains owned staging and checkpoints; deleting a checkpoint explicitly discards it. Retain completed checkpoints so published transfers are recognized on retry without retransmitting them.

Preserve established behavior across local, SSH, Kubernetes, and Prometheus connectors. Unsupported uploads return `ErrTransferUnsupported` with exact text `transfer direction unsupported` and leave no residue.

Export `TransferDirection`, `TransferID`, `TransferRequest`, `TransferResult`, `Checkpoint`, `CheckpointStore`, `FileCheckpointStore`, `NewFileCheckpointStore`, `NewTransferID`, `Connector.Transfer`, `ErrTransferIntegrity`, `ErrTransferUnsupported`, and `NewConnector` from connector; expose `ExecOptions.TransferID` from modules/internal and `TaskTransferProgress` from core/v1alpha1. `TransferID` is a string type, `Fi
